cases.sentence: Граф, переваливаясь, подошел к жене с несколько ___, как и всегда.
cases.explain: «виноватым видом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The count came waddling in to see his wife with a rather guilty look as usual.

cases.sentence: Он сел подле жены, облокотив молодецки руки на колена и взъерошивая ___.
cases.explain: «седые волосы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He sat down by his wife, his elbows on his knees and his hands ruffling his gray hair.

cases.sentence: Митенька, тот ___, воспитанный у графа, который теперь заведывал всеми его делами, тихими шагами вошел в комнату.
cases.explain: «дворянский сын» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Mítenka, a man of good family who had been brought up in the count’s house and now managed all his affairs, stepped softly into the room.

cases.sentence: — Вот что́, мой милый, — сказал граф вошедшему почтительному ___.
cases.explain: «молодому человеку» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “This is what I want, my dear fellow,” said the count to the deferential young man who had entered. “Bring me …” he reflected a moment, “yes, bring me seven hundred rubles, yes! But mind, don’t bring me such tattered and dirty notes as last time, but nice clean ones for the countess.”

cases.sentence: — ___ у меня этот Митенька, — прибавил граф улыбаясь, когда молодой человек вышел.
cases.explain: «Экое золото» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “What a treasure that Mítenka is,” added the count with a smile when the young man had departed. “There is never any ‘impossible’ with him. That’s a thing I hate! Everything is possible.”

cases.explain: «ужасном положении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “Oh, what a terrible state he is in! One would not know him, he is so ill! I was only there a few moments and hardly said a word …”

cases.sentence: Плакали они о том, что они дружны; и о том, что они добры; и о том, что подруги молодости, заняты таким ___ — деньгами; и о том, что молодость их прошла...
cases.explain: «низким предметом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Anna Mikháylovna was already embracing her and weeping. The countess wept too. They wept because they were friends, and because they were kindhearted, and because they—friends from childhood—had to think about such a base thing as money, and because their youth was over. … But those tears were pleasant to them both.
